message:
The users API test now passes, and `npm test` shows 1 pass and 0 failures.

The migration `001_create_users.js` names the column `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` read and wrote `full_name`. That caused the "unknown column users.full_name" error. I changed the two references in `src/api/users.js` to `fullname`. I didn't touch `migrations/`.
